question: When does the same rule apply to the brahma-stone and the bull as to the pedestal?
premises: A pedestal may possess proper characteristics.
The brahma-stone and bull are related ritual supports.
Suitability of one support can extend to others.
inference: If the pedestal has proper characteristics, the same applies to the brahma-stone and the bull.
plain_english: But if the pedestal has the proper characteristics, the same applies likewise to the brahma-stone and the bull.
